hero.title: Learn English with Lyn
hero.headline: Clear English.
hero.subtitle: Shadow real speech, record yourself, and get Lyn's feedback on every take. Ten years of ESL coaching, built into a method you can actually practise.
hero.trustNote: Not sure where to start? Just ask.

about.title: Meet
about.lead: Ten years of teaching English as a foreign and second language, from South Korea.
about.body1: I've spent over a decade helping non-native speakers say what they mean without second-guessing themselves. My students come from everywhere, and they're working on English for the same reasons you probably are: their job, their travel, their studies, their everyday life.
about.body2: My focus is pronunciation, accent, conversational fluency, phrasal verbs, and idioms. IELTS or TOEIC prep, Business English for meetings and presentations, or just enough confidence to stop rehearsing sentences in your head first — every lesson is built around your goals, your level, and how you actually learn.
about.pullQuote: If you're serious about improving your English, I'm serious about helping you get there.

student1.quote: I've been a student of Lyn's for over two years, and my pronunciation and overall speaking have improved so much. She gives real practice every class and genuinely cares about how I'm progressing.
student1.author: Ivan

student2.quote: Before Lyn's classes, I was afraid to speak in meetings. Now I lead presentations in English with confidence. Her feedback on my recordings changed everything.
student2.author: Min-Ji

student3.quote: The accent training membership is worth every penny. The structured sessions and Lyn's personal feedback helped me finally master the R and L sounds.
student3.author: Carlos

student4.quote: Lyn makes shadowing feel natural and fun. I practice every day now, and my colleagues notice how much clearer my English sounds.
student4.author: Yuki

student5.quote: I needed to improve my IELTS speaking score, and Lyn's focused approach got me from 6.0 to 7.5 in just three months.
student5.author: Sofia

student6.quote: Phrasal verbs and idioms used to confuse me completely. Lyn breaks them down in a way that finally makes sense in real conversation.
student6.author: Ahmed

student7.quote: The live coaching sessions are incredibly personalized. Lyn listens carefully, corrects gently, and always pushes me to speak more.
student7.author: Lin

student8.quote: My TOEIC speaking score jumped after working with Lyn. She knows exactly which sounds and patterns Korean speakers struggle with.
student8.author: Priya

student9.quote: I've tried many English teachers, but Lyn is different. She combines real-world practice with clear explanations you actually remember.
student9.author: Marco

student10.quote: Joining Lyn's Fluency Community was the best decision I made. Weekly practice with her tips keeps me motivated and improving.
student10.author: Hana

whatIsIt.question: What will I find here?
whatIsIt.answer: Lyn's pronunciation, accent, and fluency courses. Practice by shadowing real speech, recording yourself, and getting her feedback.

coursesAvailable.question: Are Lyn's courses available now?
coursesAvailable.answer: Yes, all of Lyn's courses and coaching packages are available now. Message her to get started.

existingStudent.question: I'm already a student. Where do I sign in?
existingStudent.answer: Use the Sign In link at the top of the page.

paymentOptions.question: Do you have any payment options?
paymentOptions.answer: Payment is currently handled directly with Lyn via PayPal. Get in touch to arrange payment for any course.

refundPolicy.question: What if a course doesn't match my needs? Can I get a refund?
refundPolicy.answer: Courses are digital and delivered right away, so they're non-refundable once purchased. Message Lyn first if you're not sure a course is the right fit, she's happy to help you choose.

footer.body: Tell Lyn what you're working toward and she'll point you at the course or package that fits. No sales pitch.
footer.responseNote: Payment is arranged directly with Lyn via PayPal.
